description: Prefix-range vectors for the suggestion recipe in SCHEMA.md. For each case, the BINARY-collated scan `key >= prefix AND key < prefix || U+10FFFF` over `keys` must return exactly `matches` (in key order). The keys include astral (U+1F600, U+20000) and high-BMP (U+FFEF, U+FFFD) continuations, so an implementation that uses U+FFFF (or any BMP 'max char') as the sentinel FAILS here. The builder's tests assert this file; the app's tests must assert the same file.
